Legal.mentionsDescription: Legal notices for the DT Moving Tunisia website — publisher, hosting, intellectual property.
Legal.mentionsHostingText: This website is hosted by Vercel Inc., 340 Pine Street, Suite 900, San Francisco, CA 94104, United States.
Legal.mentionsIntellectualText: All content on this website (texts, images, logos, videos) is the exclusive property of DT Moving Tunisia and is protected by applicable intellectual property laws. Any reproduction, total or partial, is strictly prohibited without prior authorization.
Legal.mentionsResponsibilityText: DT Moving Tunisia strives to ensure the accuracy and currency of information published on this site. However, we disclaim all liability for any inaccuracies or omissions.
Legal.mentionsLawText: This website is governed by Tunisian law. Any disputes relating to its use shall fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of Tunisian courts.
Legal.privacyDescription: Learn how DT Moving Tunisia collects, uses and protects your personal data.
Legal.privacyDataCollectedText: We collect only the data strictly necessary for the purposes described below:
Legal.privacyDataItem1: First and last name (quote form and client area)
Legal.privacyPurposeItem1: Process your quote request and fulfil the contract
Legal.privacyPurposeItem2: Log you into your client area (Magic Link)
Legal.privacyPurposeItem3: Send you the newsletter (if you have consented)
Legal.privacyPurposeItem4: Improve our services (anonymised statistics via Google Analytics)
Legal.privacyRetentionText: Your data is retained for 3 years from the last contact. Login data (logs) is deleted after 12 months.
Legal.privacyRightsText: Under applicable regulations, you have the following rights:
Legal.privacyRightItem1: Right of access to your data
Legal.privacyRightItem3: Right to erasure (right to be forgotten)
Legal.privacyRightsContact: To exercise your rights, contact us at: {email}
Legal.privacyThirdPartyText: We do not sell or rent your data. It may be shared with our technical sub-processors (Vercel hosting, Resend/Brevo emailing) strictly within the scope of their assigned tasks.
Legal.privacySecurityText: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss or destruction.
Legal.cookiesDescription: Learn how DT Moving Tunisia uses cookies on its website.
Legal.cookiesWhatText: A cookie is a small text file stored on your device when you visit a website. It allows the site to remember your preferences and analyse usage.
Legal.cookiesTypesIntro: This website uses the following types of cookies:
Legal.cookiesThirdPartyText: Some cookies are set by third-party services (Google Analytics, Meta Pixel). You can consult their respective privacy policies on their official websites.
Legal.cookiesControlText: You can accept or refuse non-essential cookies via the banner displayed on your first visit. You can also configure your browser to block all cookies, but this may affect certain site features.
Legal.cookiesContactText: For any questions about cookies, contact us at: {email}
